resources.string: When this Hub supports usage monitoring, its administrator and this Worker’s owner can see usage for every session, including unshared sessions. Reports may include session names, folders, harnesses, models, account identifiers, timing, token counts, costs, usage limits and collection diagnostics. This grants no terminal content or control access. Sharing and bucket choices do not change usage coverage. How a session signs in is reported as the access kind only (subscription, API key or custom endpoint); no key, URL or host. Minion adds a status-line exporter and lifecycle hooks to Claude Code for tokens, cost, limits and session activity. Your existing status line keeps working. Control the integration with usage_claude_exporter=off. Minion adds lifecycle hooks to Codex profiles on Linux, macOS and Android for session activity. Review and trust them in Codex with /hooks. Disable recording with usage_codex_exporter=off. Lifecycle hooks report event types and timing without prompt or response content.
I accept usage monitoring for this enrollment
